name: Card Kingdom
description: Search the live Magic buylist for the exact set, finish, and quantity. A listed buy price can change.

description: Dealer buying intake. Check eligible categories and reach their buyer for an actual quote.

name: Goldin
description: Request review for high-end collectibles. Ask about minimum value, fees, and auction timing.

name: COMC
description: Submit eligible cards for listing. Review intake fees, processing time, storage, and payout.

name: TCGplayer
description: Self-listing marketplace. Match the exact product, condition and finish. Check fees, restrictions and shipping.

name: eBay Product Research
description: Use exact sold comparables and check accepted offer amounts in Product Research if eligible.

name: Washington State Sports Collectors Association
description: The club forwards inventory lists to interested members. Include sports, players or teams, and quantities. Use its dealer profiles to see what dealers are seeking.

description: Public wanted post seeking older basketball collections. Posted October 25, 2026. Open the post to confirm it is still up and use its reply route. Collector identity and purchase terms are unverified.
